claim: T26 (100+ concurrent WS and SSE from a local test client) needs TinyHttpd maxConnectionsPerAddress (default 32) and maxEventStreams (default 64) raised; only maxUpgradedConnections is covered.
object.md requires header count and wait-queue length to be configurable; design only names header/URL/timeout configuration APIs and keeps header count and queue as TinyHttpd defaults.

docs/api and object.md make Logcat the default logger on Android; the design only ships a Logcat Logger in a separate artifact and makes console the JVM default, with no item for Android default selection.

Internal inconsistency: D-005 says wave 1 declares every module's main dependencies so later waves add only test deps or release plugins, but the SLF4J adapter and rotating file logger modules (D-179, wave 4) and the Android-only Logcat artifact (D-371, wave 8) are not in D-002's wave-1 module list; the Logcat artifact also needs android.jar while D-025 requires the root build to pass without an Android SDK.
object.md §9.3 calls for a ResourceResolver SPI (open, length, etag, modified) separate from the built-in File resolver; no design item covers it or records it as post-v1.
object.md §9.4 says cache defaults are configurable as a server-wide security policy; no item covers a global default CachePolicy.
CONNECT can never be enabled on the TinyHttpd adapter because TinyHttpd rejects it with 501 in the parser.
object.md §17.1 requires a Kotlin Android project to compile and run SAM, nullable, Multipart, WebSocket and service APIs; D-364 only requires Kotlin sources in the sample.
Applying the Kotlin Gradle Plugin to every module for Kotlin tests adds kotlin-stdlib to each main api configuration by default, violating D-009/D-011 unless disabled.
I-009 requires every Java example in docs/api to compile in the test suite, but the Android Service example uses android.* and cannot compile in the SDK-less root build (D-025).
